Camera: EXACT RIGHT SIDE orthographic elevation, zero perspective, zero yaw, zero pitch, no view of front/rear faces or roof top, nose to the RIGHT, rear to the LEFT. Entire vehicle, rear nacelle projection, roof antenna/pod/sign and underside pads all in frame with generous margin. Horizontally level chassis. One single profile only.
Preserve original squat faceted wedge-shaped yellow taxi, long cabin, angular windshield slope, black window pillars and smoked glazing, worn chipped yellow panels, black checker door stripe, chrome segmented lower skirt and bumper, small amber roof sign just forward of the low cylindrical roof pod with cyan side ring, TWO angular yellow armored rear nacelles on short sturdy arms. Exactly FOUR shallow circular cyan hover pads in front left/right and rear left/right pairs. In true side view opposite-side pads overlap, so show TWO visible pad silhouettes (front and rear) below the chassis with short stout vertical bolted bosses, using the underside reference's pad depth, emitter/rim structure and mounting clearance.
